entries.text: Trino and Presto `create_schema` on the Hive connector no longer writes `NOT NULL`, which Trino 476 rejects with `Catalog 'hive' does not support non-null column`; TPC-H (8 tables) and TPC-DS (25 tables) now create on a Trino Hive catalog. No published result can use this path, because schema creation failed on it.
